title: Research: sharp pooled T16 integer optimum through a = 1/7
body:
## Summary

```diff
 fixed selected-T16 pooled integer packing, unchanged optimizer
- certified only for 0.00167689 <= a <= 0.00167690
+ exact optimum for every real 0 <= a <= 1/7
```

The sharp idle cost remains `2431+17^(1-a)+4887*48^(1-a)`. This closes PR3352's second open question with a continuum sign proof using integer concavity checks and rational Taylor/Bernstein bounds. It does not change the numerical moment root, packing cap, physical supplier or selected kappa.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3352 leaves the wider optimality interval open. After: all 43,031 residue inequalities hold uniformly, reducing to 5,304 spectra: one identity, 5,228 exact concavity certificates and 75 Bernstein certificates. All nine integer inventory equations are checked against the literal selected inputs.
- An exact negative control at `a=3/20` gives slack below `-11/250` for this fixed potential. This is a certificate failure, not proof that the optimizer changes or that `1/7` is sharp.
- Python 3.12.15 registered replay, Python 3.15.0 optimized controls, seven behavioral groups, read-only Git-free source export and actual source-byte rejection pass. Ruff E/F/B/SIM, whitespace, publication-byte equality and source-history preflight pass. The original certificate bytes are retained with source hash, blob and credit; no unmerged Git object is required.
- Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-integer-uniform`. Standard library only. The package includes proof, exact receipt, source pins, failure controls and open questions.
- Base and submission refresh: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1885#discussioncomment-19007984. This is separate from current physical helper-cycle and owner-map searches.

Credit PR3352, Ali Romman/PR1129, Hanson Sun/PR1914, Chafik Boukhalfa, Rohan Arun/PR1094, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan/PR858 and the retained source lineage. Chronology, physical owner admission, paid local word, full invoice, bit/outer/all-size/analytic obligations are not newly replayed. After materializing its declared selected source roots, the card working example passes `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`; the three theorem inputs also pass direct selected-manifest binding. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Eight files add one isolated theorem package and its retained certificate.

Blast radius: package. Frozen predecessors and the selected record are unchanged. The theorem assumes the fixed whole-helper disjoint-reservation inventory contract.
